notes.rounds: maximum Agent turns per source branch (G = rollout.branching children per decision point); intervention rerun stops immediately after one fresh Agent reply and Doctor FINAL
notes.budget: full_tree only; pruning / subsampling is not defined
notes.rubric: one Rubric-Generator call -> one rubric per completed trajectory; fixed user-side / Agent-side / behavior schema; analysis.selected_agent_turn_id chooses exactly one source Agent node
notes.rubric.gold_answer_visible: Doctor feedback and the Rubric Generator never receive a gold field; final decision and outcome may imply it
notes.post_hoc_gates: blocking: schema, deterministic leakage / answer copy, configured judge answer_presupposition, configured judge new_domain_premise; recorded only: observable
notes.intervention: only the generator-selected Agent node; fixed pre-response prefix and policy; failure -> Score-2 template, success -> Score-0 template; each trial regenerates the Agent reply with the instruction, then directly calls Doctor FINAL; no subsequent discussion
notes.reruns_per_intervention: exactly 3 independent Agent generations plus Doctor FINAL calls; reply and continuation use separate recorded seeds; current Doctor API does not accept seed
notes.R_O: selected target only: failure -> successful trials / 3; success -> failed trials / 3; any incomplete/technical-error trial -> R_O=None, status=incomplete; no averaging over multiple targets
notes.selection: retain only with 3 complete trials and >=2 desired outcomes; no_match/incomplete are not retained
notes.scoring: kept rubrics score response nodes of the SAME case; applicability uses pre-response context; no_match is distinct from score 0; flat projections exist only at legacy judge/template boundaries
notes.agent_reward: existing strategy: w_outcome * mean(descendant outcomes) + w_rubric * effectiveness-weighted R_A; missing R_A omitted. These reward/aggregation choices remain undecided and are not modified here
notes.prompt_update: J(p)=mean success-source R_O * mean failure-source R_O; both sources in search and acceptance; paired stratified bootstrap of product gain; technical incompletes defer. Parent and candidates use the frozen current policy.
notes.prompt_hashes: generator hash updated for the exact accompanying prompt bytes; other hashes preserved from supplied config and not checked against server files
notes.pilot: New trainable HF policy path, not a resumption of frozen GGUF pilot. Learning rate1e-5 is an initial pilot setting, not a calibrated optimum.
notes.belief: Prefix-only reconstruction; greedy current Agent Q1/Q2 from turn2; first turn has no prior Agent belief; siblings/reruns share cached prefix state.
notes.model_roles: Rubric generation Gemini 3.8 Flash; prompt analysis Haiku 4.5; response scoring/gates GPT-6 Luna; prompt refiner stays GPT-5.6 Sol; local Doctor feedback stays Gemma. New run required; do not reuse old intervention results.
notes.batch: Up to12 cases: GPU0..3 three dialogue lanes each, same checkpoint. Prompt optimization serial case inheritance, all candidate retained rubrics score only same-case nodes. One GPU4 optimizer call per batch. Short batches at each30-case periodic checkpoint boundary.
